Disk capacity · install decision

Approve the new control plane install today

I recommend running it today. The update is built and tested, and this is the only way to activate disk capacity.

In a terminal on the Vrooli computer

cd ~/Vrooli && make rebaseline
  1. It runs the full build check, which takes several minutes.
  2. It lists the stored-data changes and waits for your confirmation before changing anything.
  3. After you confirm, it saves the installed version, pauses automatic updates, installs and checks the new version, then turns automatic updates back on.
  4. When it finishes, choose “I ran it” here so I can finish the install checks.

Before it changes anything: the full build check runs first, then the command shows the stored-data changes and asks you to confirm.

Undo: there is no automatic rollback because the old version cannot read the new stored data. A saved copy at ~/.vrooli/state/root-rebaseline/ makes a manual rollback possible.

What changes in stored data

The update changes how the control plane writes persistent state in five areas:

Disk capacity
Resources
Process records
Managed services
Operator state

The installer stops when stored fields are added, even if none are removed or renamed. That guard caused this second request in five days. A rule change could stop repeat prompts, but it needs its own operator decision.
